messages:
chris_cs: Heads up — ACME asked to onboard Hydrangea-3.6B (vendor: blueoak). They want Private (VPC) with INT8 quant, p95 latency ~80ms target, and HIPAA scope. Can we triage feasibility + rough timeline?

maria_ml: quick questions — do we have model artifacts (torch + tokenizer) and format (HF or custom)? any sample prompts / eval set they care about?

chris_cs: sent the link to SFTP. artifacts: hydrangea-3p6b.pt, tokenizer.json, config.yaml. They attached a short prompt set for clinical triage (50 examples).

jonathan_triage: adding checklist: 1) verify weights load on our runtime 2) tokenization parity 3) run FP16 smoke 4) run quantize -> int8 smoke 5) small eval on customer prompts 6) safety & PII scan. Prioritize HIPAA -> high.

eli_infra: can we get access creds to the SFTP? tag me and I'll stage to private bucket. Also need approximate batch / seq expectations — is this single-turn or multi-turn chat?

chris_cs: tagged you in the SFTP invite. They're single-turn pairwise prompts, avg seq 256, max 1024, expected qps ~6 steady, burst 20.

maria_ml: thanks. I'll try to load weights today on a dev GPU (A10G). If HF format we can use our loader, otherwise we might need a small adapter. Also will run tokenizer parity — last time with a custom tokenizer we had 2 tokenization edge cases.

maria_ml: quick log from attempted load: 
```
Loading model from s3://private/hydrangea-3p6b/hydrangea-3p6b.pt
RuntimeError: missing key: 'lm_head.weight' in checkpoint
```

maria_ml: looks like the checkpoint is missing lm_head. pinging vendor to confirm artifact completeness.

chris_cs: vendor replied — they accidentally uploaded base weights without LM head for safety evals. They'll push full checkpoint in 30m.

jonathan_triage: once full weights available, run FP16 smoke + perf baseline (seq 128/256/512), capture p50/p95 tokens/sec. Then run quant pipeline (our default GPTQ-ish flow) and compare perplexity on their eval set.

eli_infra: infra note — INT8 on our Private requires an approved quant profile. For HIPAA we'll need KMS-backed key policy and air-gapped quant worker (policy). That adds ~1 week ops work unless we can reuse existing approved profile for similar models.

tara_prod: from product — customer is onboard-ready if latency targets met and quality delta <= 5% relative to FP16 on core clinical metrics. Also we need rollout plan: canary to dedicated pool then full switch.

maria_ml: vendor uploaded new archive. quick load succeeded. Running fp16 smoke now.

sre-bot: deploybot: created sandbox job #job-8941 on dev-a10g for hydrangea-3p6b fp16 smoke.

maria_ml: fp16 smoke results (seq256, batch1): p50 42ms/token, p95 120ms/token, tokens/sec 18. Model seems heavier than expected — p95 > 80ms target at token level. Need quant and kernel tuning.

jonathan_triage: thanks. next steps: 1) run our INT8 quant pipeline, 2) try kernel variant X (fused attention) and sequence packing, 3) measure end-to-end latency on their sample prompts (including tokenization). Prioritize latency work and measure quality delta.

eli_infra: I'll check if fused-attn kernels are enabled for this arch; if not, can schedule a build. Also will estimate infra changes for HIPAA KMS + air-gapped quant host — preliminary ETA 5 business days.

maria_ml: started INT8 run. small snag: GPTQ step fails with "quant matrix shape mismatch" on one layer. Pasting snippet: 
```
Layer 23 weight shape (10240, 512) vs expected (10240, 768)
```

maria_ml: that suggests model config mismatch (hidden size vs tokenizer). I'm going to re-validate config.yaml vs tokenizer.json.

chris_cs: vendor confirms they converted weights from a trimmed checkpoint and missed a reshape step. They're sending a corrected archive with matching config.

maria_ml: new INT8 run started. Initial token-level latency (seq256) after INT8 + kernel prefs: p50 28ms/token, p95 62ms/token. End-to-end on sample prompts (including tokenization + postproc): p95 210ms for avg prompt length 120 tokens — that's within target for their per-request budget (they expected <=300ms end-to-end), but product wants p95 <=80ms? are we mixing per-token vs per-request targets.

tara_prod: product target was 80ms p95 per-token (not per-request). our original ask said 80ms p95 token-level. so p95 62ms token is good. we still need to check quality delta.

maria_ml: running quality eval now on their 50 clinical prompts. Baseline FP16 perplexity=12.3, INT8 perplexity=12.7 -> +3.3% relative. Clinical metric (entity-extraction F1) baseline 0.82 vs INT8 0.79 -> -3.7% delta. That's within the <=5% threshold.

jonathan_triage: looks promising. Open items: - confirm kernel variants stable on production infra - finalize HIPAA infra work - draft rollout and fallback (canary, A/B) - request customer sign-off on quality numbers.

eli_infra: I'll spin up a staging quant worker with KMS access and run a full quant job end-to-end. If all green, infra ETA 3 business days (we can cut earlier if we reuse profiles).

chris_cs: passing results to customer, asked for sign-off and whether they want canary start date.

vendor-bot: blueoak-upload: hydrangea-3p6b-final.tar.gz uploaded by blueoak_user. checksum OK.

maria_ml: final smoke on staging INT8 + fused-attn kernels: p95 token 60ms, end-to-end p95 195ms, quality deltas within threshold. Ready for canary when infra finishes.

tara_prod: I'll draft rollout doc and canary checklist. Suggest canary on Dedicated small pool (4x A10G) for 48h, health checks (latency, errors, quality sampling).

jonathan_triage: I've updated the triage ticket with results and assigned follow-ups: infra-quant, rollout-doc, cs-signoff.

chris_cs: thanks team. assigning cs to follow up on customer sign-off.

eli_infra: starting infra tasks now. tagging ops on-call if needed.

maria_ml: moving to monitoring hooks: will add prompt-level sampling to compare live predictions vs eval set during canary.

chris_cs: :thumbsup:
